title: NVIDIA/warp
summary: NVIDIA Warp is a Python framework for writing GPU-accelerated simulation and geometry code, with a focus on robotics, machine learning, and differentiable physics-style workloads. It lets researchers express low-level computational kernels in Python while targeting high-performance execution on GPUs, making it useful for building fast simulators, optimization loops, and robot learning pipelines.

extra.full_text: A Python framework for GPU-accelerated simulation, robotics, and machine learning.

title: Farama-Foundation/Metaworld
summary: MetaWorld is a suite of simulated robotic manipulation environments used to benchmark multi-task and meta-reinforcement-learning algorithms. It gives researchers a standardized set of robot tasks for testing whether agents can learn across tasks and adapt efficiently, making it useful for comparing generalization and transfer in robot learning.

extra.full_text: Collections of robotics environments geared towards benchmarking multi-task and meta reinforcement learning

title: isaac-sim/IsaacLab-Arena
summary: Isaac Lab - Arena extends NVIDIA Isaac Lab with a composable robotics simulation layer for building and evaluating robot learning environments at scale. It is aimed at rapid prototyping across different robot embodiments, objects, and scene setups, making it useful for comparing policies under varied task and environment configurations.

extra.full_text: Isaac Lab - Arena is a robotics simulation framework that enhances NVIDIA Isaac Lab by providing a composable, scalable system for creating diverse simulation environments and evaluating robot learning policies. The framework enables developers to rapidly prototype and test robotic tasks with various robot embodiments, objects, and environments.

title: iit-DLSLab/basic-locomotion-isaaclab
summary: iit-DLSLab/basic-locomotion-isaaclab provides an IsaacLab DirectEnv setup for training and testing basic quadruped locomotion across multiple robot platforms. It is aimed at workflows that need a practical bridge from simulation to deployment, including sim-to-sim transfer and sim-to-real pipelines for legged robots.

extra.full_text: An IsaacLab DirectEnv for basic quadrupedal locomotion tasks, with support for multiple quadruped robots, sim-to-sim, and sim-to-real pipelines

title: RobotControlStack/robot-control-stack
summary: RobotControlStack is a compact sim-to-real stack for training and deploying VLA models and reinforcement-learning agents without depending on ROS. It provides native MuJoCo/Gymnasium wrappers with synchronous execution across several robot platforms, including Franka, UR5e, xArm, SO101, and YAM, making it useful for researchers who want a lighter path from simulation experiments to real robot control.

extra.full_text: A lean, ROS-free sim-to-real framework for training and deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and RL agents. Native MuJoCo Gymnasium wrappers with synchronous execution for Franka, UR5e, xArm, SO101 and YAM.

title: ROBOTIS-GIT/cyclo_lab
summary: ROBOTIS-GIT/cyclo_lab collects reinforcement learning and imitation learning tutorials built around ROBOTIS robots, with an emphasis on taking policies from simulation onto physical hardware. It looks most useful as a hands-on Sim2Real learning and deployment resource for researchers or engineers working with ROBOTIS platforms, rather than as a standalone algorithmic contribution.

extra.full_text: This repository provides tutorials for reinforcement learning and imitation learning using ROBOTIS robots, and supports Sim2Real functionality for deploying the learned policies on real robots.

title: flexivrobotics/isaac_sim_ws
summary: Flexiv’s Isaac Sim workspace adds Flexiv robot models to NVIDIA Isaac Sim and lets them be driven through the same interfaces used on hardware: Flexiv Elements Studio or the Flexiv RDK. The useful bit is that simulation can run against the actual force/torque controller from the real robots, making it a practical setup for testing control workflows before moving to physical Flexiv arms.

extra.full_text: Add Flexiv robots to Isaac Sim and control them using Flexiv Elements Studio or Flexiv RDK with the actual force/torque controller used on real robots.

title: RoboVerseOrg/RoboVerse

extra.full_text: RoboVerse: Towards a Unified Platform, Dataset and Benchmark for Scalable and Generalizable Robot Learning
